mapper.select: select distinct scope.tenant_id as tenantId, scope.member_id as memberId from ( select tenant_id, member_id from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_rule where is_delete = 0 union select tenant_id, member_id from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_event where is_delete = 0 and alert_status in (0, 1) ) scope order by scope.tenant_id, scope.member_id

select r.rule_id as ruleId, r.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, r.product_id as productId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, r.threshold_type as thresholdType, r.threshold_value as thresholdValue, r.notify_enabled as notifyEnabled, r.rule_status as ruleStatus, r.create_time as createTime, r.update_time as updateTime from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_rule r left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and w.member_id = r.member_id and w.warehouse_id = r.warehouse_id and w.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.member_id = r.member_id and p.product_id = r.product_id and p.is_delete = 0 where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.is_delete = 0 and r.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and r.product_id = #{productId}
and (r.warehouse_id is null or r.warehouse_id in
#{allowedWarehouseId} )
and r.warehouse_id is null
order by r.rule_status, r.update_time desc, r.rule_id desc

select rule_id as ruleId, warehouse_id as warehouseId, product_id as productId, threshold_type as thresholdType, threshold_value as thresholdValue, notify_enabled as notifyEnabled, rule_status as ruleStatus from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_rule where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and rule_id = #{ruleId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_rule (tenant_id, member_id, warehouse_id, product_id, threshold_type, threshold_value, notify_enabled, rule_status, create_by, update_by) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{warehouseId}, #{productId}, #{thresholdType}, #{thresholdValue}, #{notifyEnabled}, #{ruleStatus}, #{operator}, #{operator})
mapper.update: update ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_rule set warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, product_id = #{productId}, threshold_type = #{thresholdType}, threshold_value = #{thresholdValue}, notify_enabled = #{notifyEnabled}, rule_status = #{ruleStatus}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and rule_id = #{ruleId} and is_delete = 0

update ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_rule set is_delete = 1, remove_by = #{operator}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and rule_id = #{ruleId} and is_delete = 0

update ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_event e inner join ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_rule r on r.rule_id = e.rule_id and r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and r.member_id = e.member_id inner join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory i on i.inventory_id = e.inventory_id and i.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and i.member_id = e.member_id and i.is_delete = 0 set e.alert_status = 2, e.resolved_time = now(), e.update_by = #{operator}, e.update_time = now() where e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and e.member_id = #{memberId} and e.alert_status in (0, 1) and e.is_delete = 0 and (r.is_delete = 1 or r.rule_status != 0 or not ((r.threshold_type = 1 and (i.total_quantity = 0 or i.available_quantity * 100 <= i.total_quantity * r.threshold_value)) or (r.threshold_type = 2 and i.available_quantity <= r.threshold_value)))
and e.warehouse_id in
#{allowedWarehouseId}
and 1 = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_event (rule_id, inventory_id, tenant_id, member_id, warehouse_id, product_id, alert_type, alert_status, snapshot_total_quantity, snapshot_available_quantity, threshold_type, threshold_value, alert_message, create_by, update_by) select r.rule_id, i.inventory_id, i.tenant_id, i.member_id, i.warehouse_id, i.product_id, 1, 0, i.total_quantity, i.available_quantity, r.threshold_type, r.threshold_value, concat('库存可用数量 ', i.available_quantity, '，已低于告警阈值'), #{operator}, #{operator} from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_rule r inner join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory i on i.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and i.member_id = r.member_id and i.is_delete = 0 and i.status = 0 and (r.warehouse_id is null or r.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id) and (r.product_id is null or r.product_id = i.product_id) where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.rule_status = 0 and r.is_delete = 0 and ((r.threshold_type = 1 and (i.total_quantity = 0 or i.available_quantity * 100 <= i.total_quantity * r.threshold_value)) or (r.threshold_type = 2 and i.available_quantity <= r.threshold_value)) and not exists ( select 1 from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_event e where e.rule_id = r.rule_id and e.inventory_id = i.inventory_id and e.alert_status in (0, 1) and e.is_delete = 0 )
and i.warehouse_id in
#{allowedWarehouseId}
and 1 = 0

mapper.update: update ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_event set alert_status = 1, acknowledged_by = #{operator}, acknowledged_time = now(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and alert_id = #{alertId} and alert_status = 0 and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select token_id as tokenId, token_name as tokenName, token_prefix as tokenPrefix, scopes, token_status as tokenStatus, expire_time as expireTime, callback_url as callbackUrl, last_used_time as lastUsedTime, create_time as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_sync_token where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0 order by token_status, create_time desc, token_id desc

select t.token_name as tokenName, l.request_id as requestId, l.request_path as requestPath, l.response_status as responseStatus, l.item_count as itemCount, l.result_code as resultCode, l.result_message as resultMessage, l.latency_ms as latencyMs, l.create_time as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_sync_log l inner join ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_sync_token t on t.token_id = l.token_id and t.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and t.member_id = l.member_id and t.is_delete = 0 where l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.is_delete = 0 and l.token_id = #{tokenId} order by l.create_time desc, l.sync_id desc limit 100

select b.external_order_binding_id as bindingId, b.tenant_id as tenantId, b.member_id as memberId, b.external_token_id as tokenId, b.reservation_id as reservationId, b.order_id as orderId, b.external_order_no as externalOrderNo, b.order_no as orderNo, b.request_payload_hash as payloadHash, b.callback_url as callbackUrl, b.callback_secret_hash as callbackSecretHash, r.reservation_no as reservationNo, b.create_time as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_external_order_binding b inner join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory_reservation r on r.reservation_id = b.reservation_id and r.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and r.member_id = b.member_id and r.is_delete = 0 where b.external_token_id = #{tokenId} and b.external_order_no = #{externalOrderNo} and b.is_delete = 0 limit 1 for update

mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_external_order_binding (tenant_id, member_id, external_token_id, reservation_id, order_id, external_order_no, order_no, request_payload_hash, callback_url, callback_secret_hash, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{tokenId}, #{reservationId}, #{orderId}, #{externalOrderNo}, #{orderNo}, #{payloadHash}, #{callbackUrl}, #{callbackSecretHash}, null, now(), null, now(), 0)

mapper.select: select i.inventory_id as inventoryId, i.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_code as warehouseCode, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, i.product_id as productId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, p.brand, p.model_name as modelName, p.product_type as productType, i.total_quantity as totalQuantity, i.available_quantity as availableQuantity, i.reserved_quantity as reservedQuantity, i.rented_quantity as rentedQuantity, i.repairing_quantity as repairingQuantity, i.damaged_quantity as damagedQuantity, i.stock_protection_qty as stockProtectionQty, i.calculation_mode as calculationMode, i.external_sync_version as snapshotVersion from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory i inner join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and w.member_id = i.member_id and w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id and w.status = 0 and w.is_delete = 0 inner join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and p.member_id = i.member_id and p.product_id = i.product_id and p.status = 0 and p.is_delete = 0 where i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and i.member_id = #{memberId} and i.status = 0 and i.is_delete = 0 and i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and i.product_id = #{productId} order by w.sort_no, i.warehouse_id, p.product_name, i.product_id
